name: Lakestar SPAC I SE
summary: Lakestar SPAC I SE focuses on acquiring a company in the form of a merger, capital stock exchange, share purchase, asset acquisition, reorganization, or similar transaction. It intends acquire companies in the technology sector with a focus on the sub-sectors, such as software as a service, fintech, transportation and logistics, healthtech, and deep tech. The company is based in Luxembourg City, Luxembourg.
